sources.snippet: DistilBERT over BERT — roughly 40% smaller and 60% faster while retaining about 97% of BERT's performance through knowledge distillation. The right trade-off for a model serving live inference on hundreds of comments per request.

sources.title: Social Sentiment Insights using a DistilBERT Model
sources.snippet: This study combines sentiment analysis, emoji sentiment detection, and spam detection to address the challenge of analyzing user comments on social media. It makes use of a fine-tuned DistilBERT model that classifies comments as Positive, Negative, or Neutral in sentiment and maps spam classes to identify the harmful or irrelevant content. sources.title: DistilBERT · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: DistilBERT DistilBERT is pretrained by knowledge distillation to create a smaller model with faster inference and requires less compute to train. Through a triple loss objective during pretraining, language modeling loss, distillation loss, cosine-distance loss, DistilBERT demonstrates similar performance to a larger transformer language model.

sources.title: Sentiment_Classification_using_DistilBERT.ipynb - Colab
sources.snippet: DistilBERT is a small, fast, cheap and light Transformer model trained by distilling Bert base. It has 40% less parameters than bert-base-uncased, runs 60% faster while preserving over 95% of Bert's performances as measured on the GLUE language understanding benchmark.
